description: 기상청_태양광기상자원지도 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 기상청. 태양기상자원지도는 다양한 기상정보와 지형정보를 이용하여 지표면에 도달하는 태양에너지의 강도를 시공간에 대하여 통계 분석하여 표출된 자료로, 지형에 의해 태양광이 가로막히는 현상을 고려한. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
